correctness.rationale: Exact conditional multinomial representation follows from independent Poisson streams and the unique last first arrival. Fixed-R conditional Lindeberg CLT yields Gaussian fluctuations with diagonal variance n exp(-tau)/r!. Beta(1,n) minimum yields Exp(1) mixing. Independent global inter-arrival clock ensures mean square |tau-W/n|^2=H_n/n, and the centering derivative bound vanishes after normalization; finite arithmetic checks in verify_coupon.py confirm special cases but are not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: published-finding corpus and public primary literature were searched with claim aliases and implication comparisons. The closest published results at precisely the same coupon-completion object are first-order (Saunders and Ilienko), whereas the proposed non-Gaussian R-dimensional second-order residual is a strictly finer statement. Mahmoud–Smythe explicitly excludes the superlinear completion regime. Accessible original ledgers were checked for recoverable claims and IDs; own exact one-coordinate finite generating identity does not contain this joint second-order law. Residual risk of an unlocated equivalent prior statement is acknowledged. The exact finite multivariate generating function of Foata–Han–Lass (2001) is also identified and explicitly compared: it provides the complete finite joint law, but no stated second-order asymptotic fluctuation theorem.
